author: The Kelvingrove Review
title: Looking for artist for journal cover art
content: For our upcoming issue, "Art in Times of Conflict," we’re looking for an artist or designer to create our front and back cover. To apply, email kelvingrovereview@glasgow.ac.uk with: A brief bio; A description of your proposed work and its inspiration. Contact: kelvingrovereview@glasgow.ac.uk
